title: The Greyhound station
venue: the laundromat digest — the only oversized cover of the run
logline: Chloe boards the southbound bus to Eugene to connect north. Neither waves.

panels.composition: Widescreen five-tier layout. Tier 1: the Greyhound stop on 101 in drizzle. The bus, tinted windows. CHLOE at the door with two bags.

characters.pose: boarding, two bags, not looking back

image.prompt: a Greyhound bus with tinted windows at a roadside stop on a coastal highway in drizzle, a young woman with two bags stepping up to the door, towering black Sitka spruce behind, stark black-and-white with xerox grain

panels.name: The stop

panels.composition: Tier 2: WOOD outside the tinted window, hands stuffed deep in his oversized chore coat. Her shape barely visible through the tint. Neither waves.

characters.pose: standing, hands deep in coat pockets, looking at the window

image.prompt: a thin young man in an oversized chore coat standing outside a bus with hands deep in his pockets, a faint figure behind the tinted window, neither waving, rain

panels.name: The window

panels.composition: Tier 3: the bus door folding shut. Wood's reflection in the dark glass.

image.prompt: close-up of a bus door folding shut with a young man's reflection in the dark glass, rain streaks

panels.name: The door

panels.composition: Tier 4: zoom out. Red taillights of the bus pulling away up 101.

image.prompt: a bus pulling away up a two-lane coastal highway, its taillights small, a lone figure left at the roadside stop, black spruce walls on both sides

panels.name: Taillights

panels.composition: Tier 5: the taillights disappearing around a serpentine bend of Highway 101, enveloped by towering ink-black Sitka spruces and coastal drizzle. No figure.

image.prompt: two red taillights disappearing around a serpentine bend of a coastal highway swallowed by towering ink-black Sitka spruce and drizzle, no people, stark black and white

panels.name: The bend

notes: Sundays don't exist yet in 2000; this ran as the digest's only oversized cover. The margin crab faces away.
